proved_scope: For every positive integer q and natural n>=q, ALT in sandwich form at r=n/q, with PSD inputs including singular matrices.
For every positive integer k,q, the integer-r=k ALT family, with no upper bound on either parameter.
Every finite-step Trotter comparison (3.2), for arbitrary positive k,m and PSD inputs.
The oriented comparison (3.3) T34(A,B)<=T43(B,A), and the resulting PSD strong bound p34>=T34.
scope_note: The background (3.1) for arbitrary real q>0 and arbitrary real r>=1 is not separately proved; all parameter instances used in the paper are proved without assuming that background theorem.
